outcome.technical: GATE (tools/check-report-interactive.mjs, layout matrix). layoutAtTop() now returns the bar's content box (border+padding subtracted), `spill` (every in-flow .sectools child, and every drawn rect of the count's text, outside that box by more than 0.5px), document.scrollingElement.scrollWidth against innerWidth, the count's unbroken width (measured with white-space:nowrap set for one synchronous read and restored), and whether #audit-sort is drawn inside the bar. The barNeeds packer and natural() are deleted. lm3: the count is one line wherever its unbroken text fits the bar's content box; narrower, the cell prints an ok note naming both widths and the lines, and lm8 holds it. lm4: a stated bound, LAPTOP_BAR_LINES = {rest:1, filtered:2}, asked only at sizes marked laptop (1024x768, 1512x945); states carry rest:true for every View at rest. New lm8 per cell: spill empty AND page width <= screen width. R26: TOPBAR_SCROLLS = ['top bar', '(max-width:52rem),(max-height:32rem)'] is written in the gate, not read off the stylesheet (a query read off a deleted rule asks nothing); stackInTable takes it, and where matchMedia matches it moves a sticky top bar from `pinned` (the bound) to `refused`; judgeStack's lm1 asserts refused.length === 0 first, naming the layer and its height. R27: after the matrix, count rows carrying data-porder (emitted by phase_ranks, a separate site from the toolbar's sortpick though both ask any_phase_pinned); ranks with the select drawn in fewer than every cell is a FAIL, ranks with it everywhere is an ok note, no ranks is a note that the Sort-select coverage is absent from this run. This applies to every leg, not only the live one; the gate is not told which leg it is. The matrix comment block is rewritten for lm1's refusal, lm3's condition, lm4's stated bound and lm8; the vh1 pointer comment names lm3, lm4 and lm8. CSS: controls.css #audit-count is now flex:0 1 auto (was 0 0 auto + nowrap). Its basis is its whole text, so a wrapping flex line moves it down whole; only where the text is wider than the whole bar does it shrink and wrap its words. New: @supports (field-sizing:content){.sectools>span>select{field-sizing:content}}, so the View and Sort selects are as wide as their shown option. Selected structurally rather than by .viewpick/.sortpick because pr8 counts '.sortpick' at 2 to forbid a second rule styling the Sort select (first spelled with :is(.viewpick,.sortpick), which turned pr8 red, then rescoped); the More filters selects are not direct span children of .sectools and keep their widths. forced-colors.css: the top-bar comment says lm1 fails a top bar pinning where the query matches and carries its own copy of the query. report/README.md filters.js row: one sentence on where the count goes.
